title: Isandro and the Mixtape
author: Beatrix Thackeray
blurb: Gideon Eastwick, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
